Files are copied while the site is running. Transactional MySQL dumps alone do not guarantee consistency between files and databases; non-transactional tables require a suitable strategy.

Le parent doit exister; la destination n: The parent folder must exist; the destination must not exist. Python 3.12 or later is required for safe extraction.
